title: Spear Mace Essentials
body:
Spear Mace Essentials is a competitive Minecraft PvP texture pack designed to improve spear mace pvp of normal people.

Features:
• Clean and minimal PvP textures
• Improved item and weapon visibility
• Enhanced combat experience
• Performance-friendly design
• Suitable SpearMace Gamemode.

Made by HexaDev.
